values.meaning: Headshot bonus physical damage AD ratio vs champions (base by level, plus crit-scaling portion)
values.quote: {{pp|key=%|60 to 100 for 3|1 to 13}}|ad}} {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}}
values.binNote: The by-level base (0.6/0.8/1) is the byLevelL[...] array inside CaitlynPassive#HeadShotBonusDamage, matching the wiki exactly. The critDamage term's coefficient of 1 with crit-chance scaling comes from the formula's (CriticalStrikeScaling=1 x critChance)*(1xcritDamage - 1) part; CriticalStrikeScaling=1 is the only bin row directly carrying that '1' coefficient standalone, which is why the checker matched it there rather than in the calculation row's ad-term array - both rows are cited as they jointly compose the calculation.

values.meaning: Headshot bonus physical damage AD ratio vs non-champions (flat, overrides level scaling)
values.quote: increased to {{as|110% (+ {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}) AD}} against non-champions
values.binNote: No bin row was found matching a flat 110% non-champion multiplier; CaitlynPassive#HeadShotMinionBonusDamage is a differently-shaped reduction formula (1 - byLevel) x ad and does not obviously correspond to this wiki value. Unresolved discrepancy.

values.meaning: basic attacks needed to charge a Headshot (out of brush)
basic attacks needed to charge a Headshot while in brush (stacks doubled on-attack)
values.binNote: BrushStackBonus=1 is not the threshold itself but an additive stack bonus applied per attack while in brush (CaitlynPassive#BrushAttackTotal = 1 + BrushStackBonus = 2 stacks per attack in brush). Combined with AttacksPerHeadshot=5, doubled stack gain in brush means only ceil(5/2)=3 attacks by that arithmetic, yet the wiki states 4; the bin does not carry a direct '4' value anywhere, so this is reported as an unresolved discrepancy between the wiki's stated threshold and the derivable bin arithmetic rather than a directly matching row.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks generate a stack of Count on-attack, doubled if Caitlyn is within brush.
mechanics.quote: basic attacks generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Count'' {{tip|on-attack}}, doubled if she is within {{tip|brush}}

mechanics.claim: At max stacks the next basic attack consumes all stacks on-attack to become a Headshot with an uncancellable windup.
mechanics.quote: '''Caitlyn's''' basic attack is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: Only the ordinary 100% AD portion of the attack can critically strike; the Headshot bonus is added after the crit roll.
mechanics.quote: Only the ordinary {{as|100% attack damage}} portion of the attack can critically strike. The bonus from ''Headshot'' is added after the critical strike is rolled.

mechanics.claim: Headshot is a single instance of damage, so it does not trigger on-hit-per-instance effects like Tantrum or Warden's Mail twice.
mechanics.quote: ''Headshot'' is a single instance of damage, thus does not trigger {{cais|Tantrum|Amumu}} or {{ii|Warden's Mail}} passives twice

mechanics.claim: Ability-granted Headshots (from traps/nets) trigger on-attack effects including further Headshot stacking, the same as the normal Headshot override attack.
mechanics.quote: Ability-granted ''Headshots'' are the same as the original ''Headshot'' override attack... They trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects (including stacking ''Headshot'')

mechanics.claim: Attacking a target that becomes trapped/netted while Caitlyn's attack is on cooldown refunds part of the ongoing attack cooldown, letting the next attack start sooner.
mechanics.quote: this ongoing cooldown will be refunded partially so that her next attack on them can begin earlier

mechanics.claim: Runaan's Hurricane bolts do not generate Headshot stacks since stacks are only generated on-attack.
mechanics.quote: Because ''Headshot'' stacks are generated {{tip|on-attack}}, {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nies|Wind's Fury}} bolts will not generate any

mechanics.claim: The empowered Headshot attack will not trigger against wards, though stacks are still generated when attacking them.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|ward}}s.

mechanics.claim: The full Headshot damage applies life steal.
mechanics.quote: The full damage of ''Headshot'' applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}
